predictions: Aw, dang, come on… another 15-8 week (my third one of the season already!). Any time that I'm not getting twice as many right as wrong is a time that I'm unhappy with the performance. Crap. That takes me 88-48 for the season (64.7% correct), which is… ok-ish. What is NOT ok though, is my performance with Put It on Matt's Tab. The team is 3-3 so far, and I've picked them to win 3 times and to lose 3 times. But I've been backwards on the result every single time!! Yes, I'm 0-6?!?!

Match of the week: (A Div.) The Global Element @ The Bullies. Here we are, back again! The battle for the RDL's ultimate supremacy. And never has this battle been more even than it presently is with these two titans. In 2022, 3 of the 6 matchups went to 1001, with 2 more decided in the final 501 (the one "blowout" was decided in the next-to- last 501. :o) Obviously, this one goes the distance. And obviously, I take my guys.

Match #2: (B Div.) Blindsided @ Why So Serious? Ok, the #1 question here is… why is Matt's Tab only 3-3?!?! Matt's Tab is the ONLY team to beat either of these B leaders, but they are somehow 1-3 against the other teams?? I'm confused. Well, since Matt's Tab isn't here, one of these two is about to grab sole possession of the B lead. Serious, 14-10.

Match #3: (C Div.) Trippin Bulls @ Double In Stumble Out. C division is an AWESOME pile of mess, with every match possibly going either way. But coming out of the mess at the midway point will be a small group (trio?) that is led by the winner of this super-important battle. Trippin is the point leader… but this is C, so of course they lose. 13-11.

Match #4: (F Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Ton 80 Proof. Since their week 1 debacle, Ton 80 has been burning and pillaging through the F villages. Dart Side is one of three challengers still within a match, but to say they have been up and down would be a strong understatement. Despite the Idiots' and Sofa's strong showings so far, I still think this pairing is the most likely lead F pairing. Ton 80 opens the gap, 14-10.

Match #5: (G Div.) Runs with Corks @ Nein Mark. Rippin Darts (as predicted in the preseason by somebody) is running away with the G title. The winner of this match will likely be the only team in the division within 2 matches of the lead at the midway point. Corks eke it out, 13-11.

Match #6: (E Div.) Hump Day! @ Sharky's Machine. The easiest descriptor here is that this is the fight for 2nd in E. And it is. But it also feels like it's already the fight for a climb to D in the fall, as this pair feels a ways ahead of the pack to this point. Hump Day, 13-11?

Matches #7 & #8: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Show Me Your Tips; Nine Lives @ Rif Raf. As noted in match #3 earlier, C division is just a lovely mess of confusion and consternation. If the right teams win these two matches, FIVE of the seven C teams will be at 0.500 at the midpoint (and the other two teams would only be one match from that!). And you know what… this story is just better if they do, so let's take them both!! Sanchez in the final 501, and Rif Raf in 1001.

Match #9: (A Div.) Liver Alliance @ Lunatic Fringe. The winner here will come out with 2 losses and still be within reach of the A crown. But the loser will have 3 and likely be too far out to control their own fate much. I think Liver comes through in this one, 14-10.

Match #10: (E Div.) That's What She Said @ Irish Ton. Given that these two have far fewer points than the rest of E, this might well be a battle to avoid a drop to F next season. I don't know if I can pick She Said until they win at least one DCkt. So… Irish Ton, 13-11.

Match #11: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Consistently Inconsistent. Somebody is about to establish themselves as one of the top five teams in the entirety of RDL. Pretty rarified air up here. And one of these teams has Jimmie Jones while the other does not. CI, 14-10.

Match #12: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Dysfunctional Outlaws. Here's another early fight to avoid a bottom-two spot (and the likely drop the next season). This is going to be close, but I'll go Outlaws, 13-11.
And the remaining 11 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: Matt's Tab 14, Boom Baby 10; Iceman's 13, Uber Out 11.
D Division: Off Constantly-Reboot 14, BullsHit 10; One Armed Bandits 15, Cheap Shots 9; Menace 2 Sobriety 13, Rangers 11.
E Division: Bad Mutha Duckas 16, Death Throw 8.
F Division: Village Idiots 15, Shark Shooters 9; Bangin The Wire 13, Neighborhood Dart Knights 11; Sofa Kings 14, Shoot-Da-Bull 10.
G Division: Rippin Darts 17, Rock Bottoms 7; Punk 13, Throw It 11.
